name: Portimão
mandate: PrompTugal.news Portimão: AI and technology in Portimão, a council and a water company putting AI to work in public services, a smart-city incubator and a private higher-education institute, and what reaches Portimão from the Algarve, Portugal and the world. Independent; every fact sourced.

gravity.text: On the public record, Portimão's AI centre of gravity is its own public sector and its university plans. The council is rolling out an AI-checked online urban-licensing platform and has a digital-transformation grant that lists AI among its areas, the municipal water company EMARP is using AI acoustic loggers to find leaks, and the council and the University of Algarve have agreed a technology campus with digital, data and AI as focus areas. Around that sit a smart-city incubator at the Autódromo Internacional do Algarve (whose own list names a V2X and AI startup, Guepardo), the ISMAT higher-education institute with an AI course unit, and a steady run of local AI talks, books and seminars.

ai_news.title: Portimão hosts its first tourism-and-computing conference, with AI on the programme
ai_news.summary: The first TMCT conference met in Portimão in early November (Barlavento gives 4 to 6 November, O Algarve 5 to 7 November), organised with the council and the local tourism association, with Algarve Evolution, Zoomarine Algarve, Parkalgar and the hospitality school engaged to link it to regional stakeholders. Sessions covered AI in research, education and academic publishing, and an editors' summit looked at AI and research integrity.
ai_news.ai_path: A tourism-technology conference whose sessions are partly about AI, with Algarve Evolution among the stakeholders it engaged.

ai_news.title: Municipal communication seminar in Portimão is all about AI
ai_news.summary: The 35th International Seminar on Municipal Communication ran at the TEMPO municipal theatre on 29 and 30 October, organised by OmniSinal with the council, on communication challenges in the age of AI, including disinformation and crisis communication.
ai_news.ai_path: The seminar's theme is AI and its effect on local government communication.

ai_news.title: AI and sensors turn Portimão's riverside into an interactive light show
ai_news.summary: At the Noitada Portimão festival on 24 and 25 July, two installations called Magic Wall and Universos Paralelos used AI and real-time motion sensors so visitors could interact with the art.
ai_news.ai_path: AI is the technology inside the festival's interactive installations.

ai_news.title: Portimão council puts AI into online building licensing
ai_news.summary: The council is rolling out a digital urban-management platform whose AI module checks documents at the moment of submission and holds incomplete files. The council says about seven in ten dispatches from its case-handling section ask for corrected documents, and it receives roughly 5,000 licensing requests a year. Staff training began in July with full operation expected in the following months.
ai_news.ai_path: The council itself is deploying AI inside a public service.

ai_news.title: Portimão entrepreneurs meet to talk leadership, innovation and AI
ai_news.summary: The Future Business Summit on 19 June at Casa Manuel Teixeira Gomes, promoted by StartUP Portimão and the council's business incubator, included a panel on the human factor in the age of AI, covering digital literacy, cybersecurity and AI use in companies.
ai_news.ai_path: A local business event with a dedicated AI panel.

ai_news.title: Council wins about 938,000 euros to modernise digital services
ai_news.summary: Portimão's application under call ALGARVE-2025-13 was approved, worth about 938,717 euros in total investment. It covers municipal technology infrastructure, platform security, Wi-Fi management and automation of administrative processes. The article lists AI among the project areas but gives no detail on how it will be used.
ai_news.ai_path: A council digital-transformation grant that names AI as one of its project areas.

ai_news.title: UAlg and the council keep their Portimão campus plan moving
ai_news.summary: A Lusa report republished by O Algarve Económico says the university's leadership and the council met to align the university's Horizonte2030 plan with the municipal master plan for a campus at Barranco do Rodrigo. It keeps the 2028 target and puts the investment at about 8 million euros (the January 2025 report said about 15 million). No tender is described and this report does not mention AI.
ai_news.ai_path: Progress report on the planned campus whose focus areas, in the earlier Barlavento report, include AI.

ai_news.title: Portimão presents a practical book on using AI at work
ai_news.summary: The book IA como Copiloto, a 180-page guide on using generative AI tools in everyday work, was presented on 20 February at the auditorium of the Escola de Hotelaria e Turismo de Portimão, with Territórios Criativos moderating a debate called AI: adapt or fall behind.
ai_news.ai_path: A local launch and debate about using generative AI in the workplace.

ai_news.title: Portimão's water company uses AI sensors to hunt leaks
ai_news.summary: EMARP, the municipal water and waste company, bought 20 acoustic loggers from Tecnilab that use AI to monitor the network and send daily alerts on probable leaks, starting at Urbanização Monte Canelas in Mexilhoeira Grande. A separate campaign by B.Efficient covers 130 km of mains. Both are funded by the Fundo Ambiental.
ai_news.ai_path: A municipal utility has bought AI-driven monitoring hardware.

ai_news.title: Portimão and the University of Algarve plan a technology campus with AI at its core
ai_news.summary: The council signed a protocol with UAlg for a new campus at Barranco do Rodrigo, on land and with a design provided by the council. Its focus areas are digital, data and artificial intelligence, with completion targeted for 2028 and courses from 2029, at an estimated total of about 15 million euros that was not fully secured at the time. UAlg then had more than 400 students in Portimão and aims for about 1,500 after three years.
ai_news.ai_path: A planned university campus whose stated focus areas include artificial intelligence.

gaps: Only one AI company based in Portimão turned up: Guepardo, a V2X and AI startup listed on the StartUP Portimão incubator's own page. Its website and that page are the only sources, with no independent reporting, and a later search found nothing else. A business-register search and the incubator's current member list are the next step.

postal.pt, Sul Informação, Visit Portimão, Algarve Vivo and EMARP's own site showed a bot challenge or refused access, so they were not used. Their Portimão AI stories (the Filosofia na Cidade talk on 6 March 2026, the council's earlier AI items) need a source we can open.
The council's own site shows no news feed or RSS: Viva Portimão is the place to watch, and we found no feed there.
No dated AI event after 15 November 2026 was found in Portimão. The two ISMAT workshops listed are general technology events.
Reports of the TMCT conference give different dates (4 to 6 and 5 to 7 November), so the page says early November. Algarve Evolution's exact role in it is not stated.

The UAlg campus plan: a January 2025 report names digital, data and AI as focus areas (about 15 million euros), and a February 2026 report keeps the 2028 target at about 8 million euros without mentioning AI or a tender. Its current status and any AI courses are not confirmed, and UAlg's own site and the council should be checked.
The investment map has public funding and grants but no named private investor: the August 2026 Pitch & Match names none. Investor lists and a business-register search are the next step.
No local talent is listed yet: the public speakers found are private individuals at events and we list none without their agreement.
Founders' routes beyond the incubator and the cowork space, such as the council's business desk and national funding schemes, were not found on a page we could open.

voice.lede: Ó pá, Portimão: sardines on the grill, sun on the cliffs and, believe it or not, a council that lets a robot check your building papers.
voice.mandate: PrompTugal.news Portimão: the AI and tech news of the town where the Arade meets the sea, from a council with a clever licensing robot to a water company with ears for leaks, plus what reaches us from the Algarve, Portugal and the world. We are independent, and every fact has its source, pá.
voice.gravity: Portimão's brainpower is, chiça, mostly public. The câmara is teaching a robot to read licensing papers, has a grant with AI in the small print and has shaken hands with the university on a campus for digital, data and AI. EMARP has AI ears on the pipes, and the incubator at the racetrack and ISMAT keep the young ones busy. The rest is talks, books and seminars, and we like a good tertúlia.
voice.gaps_intro: Here is what we could not find, and no, we did not look under the sardines.

start_company.name: StartUP Portimão, business incubator
start_company.what: The council's incubator, part of the Centro de Negócios de Portimão at the Autódromo Internacional do Algarve, for projects with growth potential in smart cities (energy, mobility, tourism, governance, quality of life). It has an apply section on its site and a services page.

start_company.name: StartUP Portimão acceleration programme
start_company.what: The 7th edition of the incubator's accelerator for entrepreneurs and business projects in the Algarve: skills, stronger business models and new market opportunities. Applications closed on 28 October 2026, with a first online bootcamp on 2 and 3 November and a second in person in Portimão on 24 and 25 November 2026. No AI theme is stated.

start_company.name: Portimão Cowork (council shared workspace)
start_company.what: A council shared workspace open to people and organisations with an idea, project or business that adds value to the local economy, with a continued regime and a daily regime, each with its own form and operating rules.

start_company.name: Pitch & Match
start_company.what: A session at StartUP Portimão's ninth anniversary on 10 August 2026 meant to connect entrepreneurs, business people, mentors and potential investors. No investor organisation is named in the report.

start_company.name: Mentors and partner network of StartUP Portimão
start_company.what: In 2022 the incubator reported more than 40 mentors, more than 45 partner entities and 25 startups hosted. Its site has sections for national and local partners, an advisory board and mentors.

investors.name: Digital-transformation grant, call ALGARVE-2025-13
investors.what: Approved investment for the council's digital services, covering infrastructure, security, Wi-Fi and automation, with AI listed among the project areas.
investors.ai_path: The grant lists AI among its project areas.

investors.name: Regional funding call for the UAlg technology campus
investors.what: A call of 10 million euros at 60% funding, with the application to ALGARVE 2030 expected around February 2025, for a campus whose focus areas are digital, data and AI. Funding was not fully secured at the time of the report.
investors.amount: 10 million euros available in the call
investors.ai_path: Funds a campus whose stated focus includes AI.

investors.name: Fundo Ambiental, EMARP leak-control projects
investors.what: Funds two leak-detection projects of the municipal water company, including the AI acoustic loggers.

investors.name: CRESC Algarve 2020 (FEDER) funding for the Celerator technology hub
investors.what: 4 million euros of European funds in a 7.2 million euro mobility and energy technology hub beside the Autódromo, run by Parkalgar and UAlg. No AI work is stated.
